symptoms: A repository-controlled project .env can still set HOLON_ROOT_CA_PATH, HOLON_CA_BUNDLE_PATH and HOLON_SECRET_BUNDLE_PATH; the role dispatcher then trusts a CA from the repository, overwrites a file the repository chooses, or takes HOLON_AGENT_KEY from a repository bundle. Refuse these keys in the project layer.
